#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
const ll MOD = 998244353;

ll modExp(ll x, ll y) {
    if (y == 0) return 1;
    if (y == 1) return x;
    ll ret = modExp(x, y >> 1);
    ret = ret * ret % MOD;
    if (y & 1) ret = ret * x % MOD;
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m, k;
    cin >> n >> m >> k;

    int maxJ = min(n, k);
    vector<vector<ll>> dp(k + 1, vector<ll>(maxJ + 1, 0));
    dp[0][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= k; ++i) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= maxJ; ++j) {
            dp[i][j] = (dp[i][j] + dp[i - 1][j] * j % MOD) % MOD;
            dp[i][j] = (dp[i][j] + dp[i - 1][j - 1] * (n - j + 1) % MOD) % MOD;
        }
    }

    ll invm = modExp(m, MOD - 2);
    ll res = 0;
    ll prob = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i <= maxJ; ++i) {
        res = (res + dp[k][i] * prob % MOD) % MOD;
        prob = prob * invm % MOD;
    }

    cout << res << "\n";
    return 0;
}
